description: Halo, a living halo of the moon, a big glowing ring of pale silver-white moonlight with a faint rainbow rim floating in the air, a calm cold face of moonlight in its centre, small frost crystals orbiting it, an abstract creature, a bold simple silhouette filling the whole picture, few big readable shapes, strong light and dark contrast, a crisp dark outline, little fine detail, eerie and menacing, floating, full body, the ring alone, no moon, no ground, no background, the whole ring inside the picture
